question: What is the highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with the lowest annual delivered orders volume among 2016, 2017, and 2018?
sql:
-- Verify: highest monthly delivered orders volume in the year with lowest annual volume
WITH annual_volumes AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as year,
    COUNT(*) as annual_volume
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
),
lowest_year AS (
  SELECT year FROM annual_volumes
  WHERE year IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  ORDER BY annual_volume ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_volumes AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as year,
    CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) as month,
    COUNT(*) as monthly_volume
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER),
           CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT mv.monthly_volume as highest_monthly_delivered_orders_volume
FROM monthly_volumes mv
JOIN lowest_year ly ON mv.year = ly.year
ORDER BY mv.monthly_volume DESC
LIMIT 1
